name: Novak Djokovic
signature: lean, flexible build with short dark hair
source: personality: public media, one link per claim in `sources` (Nov 5 2026); signature/build: general public knowledge, still to check against images; outfits wait on uploads (#18) Body numbers added Nov 11 2026 from the 2026 ATP media guide where the player is listed, otherwise the source named in body.

grass.notes: all-white dress code; trim colours to research

hard.notes: 2025 US Open: all black with gold piping (Lacoste's collection note, and Sports Illustrated). The piping is not drawn as a logo.

clay.notes: Neutral default kit. A citable clay colour was not found for this run.

personality.temperament: fierce, self-believing competitor; emotional, sometimes fights the crowd and then wins it over
personality.style: elastic defender and returner: slides into splits on hard courts, best return in the game, deep two-handed backhand
mannerisms: bounces the ball many times before serving, more when under pressure
celebrations: 'heart throwing': hands from the chest out to all four sides of the stadium
personality.notes: public media for mannerisms and celebrations; playing style is general knowledge

admits the long bouncing 'is annoying for a lot of people'
heart gesture to all four sides; hits his chest
'I still believe I can beat them all, otherwise I wouldn't be here' (AO 2026)
style: one of the best returners in history, most return games won of any active player (ATP)
style: perhaps the greatest returner in men's history
style: slides on the stretch into low splits on hard courts (commentary, The Racquet)

all-black night kit at the 2025 US Open

reachM.note: Same formula as bodyStats() in index.html. Not a measured wingspan. datasets/players/<id>/body.json does not exist yet (Body Scout has not run).

letRate.note: Same range already used for Sinner (0.02) and Alcaraz (0.03): lets on roughly 1–3% of pro serves. Not counted from a match log.

skills.scale: 1–20, 10 = neutral, the Skills Coach scale in src/skills/skills.js
skills.note: Not a measured rating. Set from the published style already in this file (serve size, footspeed, touch) so the locker room is not all 10s.

torsoScale.note: look.torso in src/players/roster.js is a pixel width multiplier taken from words already in signature/exaggerate (lanky, broad, slim). It is not a measured shoulder width.

favouriteServes.summary: Accurate serve, not the biggest; the return is the famous shot.
